quarterly_data.quarter: Kingboard Laminates annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (year ended 31 December 2025): revenue HK$20,400.2 million, +10% over 2024; EBITDA HK$4,204.6 million, +42%; underlying net profit attributable to owners HK$2,494.3 million, +85% (reported net profit HK$2,442.2 million, +84%). The Laminates Division's revenue rose 10% to HK$20,225.3 million and its EBITDA 22% to HK$3,676.6 million; the Property Division's revenue fell 39% to HK$77.6 million. The chairman's statement attributes the year to exceptionally strong demand for AI-related electronic products, significantly higher unit prices overall and higher sales volumes, with the share of high-end, high-value-added products in the sales mix rising.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kingboard Laminates annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Laminates Division 2025 (chairman's statement): demand for specialty electronic fibreglass yarn and specialty electronic fibreglass fabric used in 5G and 5.5G, AI servers and IC packaging substrates grew significantly, leading to a sustained supply shortage; some existing market capacity for traditional yarn and fabric was redirected to AI-related products, tightening traditional supply. Multiple price increases lifted the electronic fibreglass yarn and fabric business's profit above HK$600 million in 2025, 70% growth over 2024; a sharp rise in copper prices let the Group raise laminate prices several times, offsetting raw-material costs and improving the division's gross profit margin. The vertically integrated chain (AI electronic fibreglass yarn and fabric, copper foil, epoxy resin, bleached kraft paper) kept supplies stable during the shortage. The Directors' report states the Group is operating at close to full capacity in its existing glass epoxy laminates plants, so growth depends on new capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: electronic fibreglass yarn and fabric profit exceeded HK$600 million in 2025 (+70%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Kingboard Laminates annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AI materials (chairman's statement, prospects): low-Dk and low-CTE electronic fibreglass yarn for 5G / 6G and AI servers is in short supply. The Group's first low-Dk yarn kiln (annual capacity 500 tonnes) in Qingyuan, Guangdong started production in H1 2025; it has developed second-generation low-Dk and low-CTE yarn, and its low-CTE electronic fibreglass products have received customer certification and entered the high-end packaging substrate market. Plans: three more 500-tonne kilns for second-generation low-Dk / low-CTE yarn in H1 2026, then another eight 500-tonne kilns (low-Dk, low-CTE and quartz yarn), taking the industrial park to twelve specialty yarn kilns; the Shaoguan facility (70,000 tonnes a year of yarn and 96 million metres of fabric) to start production in H2 2026, on schedule; a new 21,000-tonne-a-year copper foil plant under construction in Guangdong for high-frequency, high-speed, low-signal-loss RTF and HVLP copper foil, scheduled to start production in mid-2027. The Group has developed HVLP3 copper foil for AI servers and ultra-thin VLP copper foil for IC packaging substrates, and its high-end laminates are certified by several world-leading Tier-1 automotive component makers and key domestic and international telecom customers.
quarterly_data.figure: first low-Dk kiln 500 tonnes a year (H1 2025); 3 more kilns in H1 2026 plus 8 more, to twelve specialty kilns; Shaoguan 70,000 tonnes yarn and 96 million metres fabric (H2 2026); copper foil plant 21,000 tonnes a year (mid-2027)

quarterly_data.quarter: Kingboard Laminates annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Prospects (chairman, 16 March 2026): entering 2026, overall demand in the electronic market remains robust, with continued strong demand for AI data centres, robotics and computing; high-performance, high-reliability, high-stability laminates are expected to become the mainstream requirement. The Group is steadily increasing its share of mid-to-high-end products (high-frequency, high-speed, mid-to-high heat-resistant, halogen-free and prepreg materials) and has developed high-frequency, high-speed products for AI servers, new energy vehicles and energy storage systems. Management expects the Group's electronic fibreglass yarn and fabric capabilities to generate satisfactory profits going forward, given the severe supply-demand imbalance that is forcing laminate producers into production disruptions.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kingboard Laminates annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Legal proceedings (contingent liabilities note): Annuity & Re Life Ltd, then the non-controlling shareholder of subsidiary Kingboard Copper Foil Holdings (KBCF), brought a Settlement Action in the Supreme Court of Bermuda alleging breach of a settlement agreement; on 18 August 2025 the court rejected the claims with costs awarded to KBCF. The petitioner filed a notice of appeal on 26 September 2025 (served 8 December 2025) and a separate costs appeal, heard on 12 January 2026. Based on its Bermuda counsel's advice, management considers the appeals intrinsically defective and expects a more than reasonable chance to succeed, so no provision has been made.
